name: resume
description: Build and review software engineering résumés from an evidence chain, not a template, in the manner of Richard Feynman and W. Edwards Deming. Applies the three-reader standard (parser, recruiter, engineering interviewer): every claim carries context, action, constraint, result, and ownership; every number is asked by what method; the person's contribution is separated from the system's. review judges a résumé in two phases (up to eight ranked questions, then re-score on the answers into a prediction and a fix list) and never emits an ATS score. build harvests accomplishments one at a time into a win log with provenance, writes five-part bullets, assembles a few coherent versions per role family, runs the two pre-apply tests, and sets up tracking. Subcommands: review, build.
